Outstanding performance. Crystal optics. Self-tinting lens with category 0-4 light transmission, effective anti-fogging and a secure fit. uvex victorious pro V – built for victory.

Minimalist styling. Seamless fit. Crystal optics. The uvex victorious pro V goggles combine an aerodynamic design with top performance and comfort – ideal for the excitement of racing and maximum output on the racetrack. No matter what the conditions. A real highlight of these goggles is the spherical double lens with self-tinting uvex variomatic® technology and category 0-4 light transmission. Which means the uvex victorious pro V can adjust from foggy conditions through to sunlight bouncing off a glacier within a matter of seconds, and with 100% UVA, UVB and UVC protection. The uvex supravision® anti-fog coating also ensures mist-free vision. The triple-layer, curved face foam offers a wider field of vision and a close, snug fit. A 50-mm-wide head strap with silicone grippers keeps the goggles in place no matter how fast you’re going. And the Over the Glasses (OTG) design makes them a hot tip for people who wear glasses. uvex victorious pro V – victorious technology. Ski goggles with a clear advantage.
Sun protection: 100% UVA, UVB, UVC protection up to 400 nm
Clear vision: self-tinting, spherical double lens with uvex variomatic® technology and category 0-4 light transmission
Mist-free lens: uvex supravision® anti-fog coating
Snug fit: flexible frame with triple-layer, curved velour face foam for a wider field of vision and 50-mm-wide head strap with silicone grippers for a secure fit
Glasses compatible: Over the Glasses (OTG) design

Smooth transition. Adaptive tint. Flexible eye protection – no matter what the light. That’s thanks to uvex variomatic® photochromic lenses. They automatically adjust light transmission and smoothly switch through categories 0-4. No lens changing required.

Mist-free vision. Clear optics. Reliable clarity – which means better safety in poor conditions. That’s thanks to uvex supravision® lens technology. A special anti-fog coating prevents lenses from misting up, without affecting optical quality. And for twice as long as the standard. Pure optical joy.
